Government spent over Rs 910 crore on print advertisements in five years

The central government spent Rs 910 crore on advertisements in print media over a five-year period. The Times of India was the largest recipient of these advertising funds. Separately, the Uttar Pradesh government reportedly spent Rs 2.3 crore daily on advertisements over eight years, exceeding the central government's spending in that timeframe.
